items.q: What is BIOTRACK and what is it for?
items.a: BIOTRACK is an environmental monitoring platform that allows citizens to report suspicious illegal sand extraction activities, track their complaints, and support the protection of rivers and coasts in the Dominican Republic.

items.q: How do I track my report?
items.a: When you submit your complaint you receive a unique tracking code. You can use it in the "Search reports" section to see the status, progress, and actions associated with your case.

items.q: What kind of evidence can I attach?
items.a: You can attach photos, videos, PDF documents, and audio files in JPG, PNG, MP4, MP3, and PDF formats. Visual evidence significantly strengthens case verification.

items.q: How long does the verification process take?
items.a: The average first review time is 3.4 hours. Once verified, the case moves to follow-up and, if necessary, corrective actions are coordinated with the relevant authorities.
Yes. BIOTRACK manages all data under institutional security controls, including encryption of sensitive information. We do not share your information with third parties.
